g.text: SYS01 - Queueing deploy, rollback and automatic recovery
Previous release is restored and verified
Manual rollback run B arrives during recovery
Queue run B; it cannot acquire slot yet
Archive run A failure and recovery evidence
Start run B; acquire same exclusive slot
Re-read active manifest/schema; run rollback eligibility checks
Activate requested release under VM lock
so up to 100 runs wait rather than replacing a pending run.
Only one operation mutates the VM at a time. Automatic recovery
remains inside run A and holds its slot. A VM-side lock is a second guard.
The independent main.yml CI workflow does not touch this queue or VM.
